subject: [PATCH 3/3] selftests: cover readdir resuming at a removed entry

2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch adds a new test case to the kernfs selftests suite called readdir_resume_at_removed_entry. The test covers the scenario where a directory listing is resumed at an entry that has been removed and then re-added. The test takes a cookie for every entry, removes each one in turn, seeks to its corresponding cookie, and reads the rest of the entries. This ensures that the kernel correctly resumes reading from the correct position after an entry has been removed and re-added.
